caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, which is a long, voluminous skirt shown against a plain, light beige background. The skirt is rendered in shades of brown, with darker diagonal lines and folds suggesting the texture and draping of the fabric. The waistband is light in color, almost white, and contrasts with the darker skirt fabric. The bottom of the skirt features an ornate, wide decorative band with a floral and geometric pattern, using slightly darker colors to highlight the embroidery or lace detail. The overall composition is centered, with the skirt occupying most of the space on the page. There is text in the bottom right corner giving credit to the artist and the associated art project.
title: Petticoat
